name: iSpring Learn
summary: iSpring Learn is an LMS sold on published per-user prices for its Business plan: $6.91 per user a month for 100 users, falling to $3.97 at 500 users, billed annually. It supports SCORM 1.2 and 2004, learning tracks with a strict completion order, automatic assignments and content and people reports.

facts.text: The Business plan is priced at 100, 300 and 500 user tiers, with annual prices of $8,286, $16,050 and $23,790.
A 30-day trial with no credit card required is offered on the pricing page.
Learning tracks can enforce a strict completion order so learners advance only after finishing the current chapter.
The mobile app lets learners study offline, and progress syncs when they reconnect.
Native connectors named on the product page are Salesforce, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Exchange and BambooHR, plus course libraries from Udemy, Go1 and LinkedIn Learning.
